$Comment: The Headless Horseman on foot, once he is thrown from the saddle: a Variant of Template_Intelligent carrying the game's Burnt Praetorian's own Modify, with his look, his health, his longsword and his own combat evaluator (CAE_Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman: sword swings, a charge and a lantern bomb, never burning). He only exists inside his fight: the fight's script swaps him in from Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted, and his health carries across, so MaxHealth here must equal the mounted role's. DropList Empty, since his reward is the Claims his fight pays. KnockbackScale 0 keeps hits from shoving him; the leash is long because the fight, not the leash, decides when he resets. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.
